description: The capture-path contrast (spec section 5, Automatic linkage alone; prompts/20 Step 6): SC1 with the raw device layer on, each preset on manual_transcription and on adapter_ingest, paired by seed. The seed list is written here before any run: at least 20 seeds (A103), neutral integers, none date-shaped, chosen by hand and not a function of any result. Stochastic, reported with the seed count and the spread, never gated. The export schedule (A216) is named per block before any run: the first block, per_run, holds the timing fixed (each result reaches the host at the instant it is produced on both paths), so only the path changes and the block is linkage alone; the second block, window_end, is a timing sensitivity (export at the end of the staffed window against an entry delay that is not modelled, spec 2.4.8) and is not linkage alone. The calendar anchor is a synthetic Monday and the instrument zone a scenario input (A161).

blocks.label: linkage alone: export per run, so a result reaches the host at the instant it is produced on both paths
timing sensitivity: export at window end (A216) against an entry delay that is not modelled; not linkage alone
